title: [NSSP-2034] Copy Campaign with SLA Validation
content: [NSSP-2034] Copy Campaign with SLA Validation As an Advertiser or Admin I want to copy an existing campaign while enforcing product availability, rate availability, and SLA cutoff validation So that I can quickly reuse campaign configurations without creating invalid bookings or violating publisher booking rules. Business Rules Copy Campaign is available from the Campaign Listing actions menu. Campaign configuration is copied, but creatives are never copied and must be re-uploaded. Billing information may be prefilled, but payment information must not be copied. A new payment transaction is required through Naviga Pay. Campaign statuses must be reset and follow the standard Propel lifecycle. Campaigns cannot bypass approval or creative validation workflows. Product availability, rate availability, and SLA cutoff validation must be evaluated independently for every copied campaign line. Campaign booking must be blocked whenever any remaining campaign line violates cutoff rules until the issue is corrected or removed. No provisional booking records may be created when cutoff validation fails. # Scenario Acceptance Criteria (Given / When / Then) 1 Launch Copy Campaign Given an existing campaign is displayed in Campaign Listing When the user selects "Copy Campaign" from the action menu Then the system shall open a new campaign in Copy Mode. 2 Copy Campaign Configuration Given a valid source campaign exists When Copy Mode is initialized Then the system shall prepopulate campaign configuration, publications, channels, products, rates, scheduling configuration, and billing address information. 3 Reset Campaign Lifecycle Given a campaign is copied When the new campaign record is created Then all campaign lifecycle statuses shall be reset to their initial state and the campaign shall follow the standard approval workflow. 4 Copy Naming Convention Given a campaign named "Summer Sale" is copied When Copy Mode loads Then the campaign name shall default to "Copy of Summer Sale". 5 Clear Creative Assets Given the source campaign contains creative assets When the copied campaign is created Then all creative files, uploads, and asset references shall be removed and the Upload Ad step shall be empty. 6 Reset Payment Information Given the source campaign contains payment information When the copied campaign is created Then billing address information may be prefilled and all payment transaction data shall be cleared. 7 Product Availability Validation Given a copied campaign contains one or more products When validation executes Then each product shall be validated independently to confirm it is still active and available. 8 Disabled Product Handling Given a copied line references a disabled product When Copy Mode loads Then the user shall be taken directly to the resolution flow for that line. 9 Replace Disabled Product Given a copied line contains a disabled product Then the system shall remove the disabled line 10 Rate Availability Validation Given a copied campaign contains rates When validation executes Then each rate shall be validated independently to confirm it remains active and available. 11 Disabled Rate Handling Given a copied line references a disabled rate When Copy Mode loads Then the user shall be required to select a replacement rate before continuing. 12 Replace Disabled Rate Given a copied line contains a disabled rate When the user selects a replacement rate Then all schedule selections for that line shall be cleared and reselected. 13 SLA Cutoff Validation Given a copied campaign contains scheduled products When cutoff validation executes Then every campaign line shall be independently validated against configured cutoff rules. 14 Empty Calendar Requirement Given the user is correcting an SLA violation When the scheduling calendar opens Then no dates from the source campaign shall be preselected. 15 Multiple Validation Issues Given a campaign line contains both a disabled rate and an expired schedule When validation begins Then the rate issue shall be resolved before schedule correction is allowed. 16 Preserve Valid Lines Given a copied campaign contains both valid and invalid lines When invalid lines are corrected or removed Then valid lines shall remain unchanged and prepopulated. 17 Block Campaign Booking Given one or more campaign lines remain invalid When the user attempts to book the campaign Then campaign booking shall be blocked. 18 Booking Error Message Given booking is blocked due to validation failures When the user attempts to proceed Then the system shall display a clear validation message identifying corrective actions required. 19 Enable Booking After Resolution Given all invalid lines have been corrected or removed When validation is re-executed Then booking functionality shall become available. 20 Remove All Lines Given every campaign line is removed during resolution When the last remaining line is removed Then the copy operation shall be cancelled and the user returned to Campaign Listing. 21 No Available Rates Given a replacement product has no active rates When rate selection loads Then the system shall display an error and require the user to select another product or remove the line. 22 Audit Logging Given a copied campaign is created or modified during validation resolution When any status, product, rate, or schedule change occurs Then the system shall create an audit log entry capturing the action and timestamp. 23 Lifecycle Compliance Given a copied campaign is successfully submitted When campaign processing begins Then the campaign shall follow the standard Propel lifecycle of submission, creative review, approval, scheduling, and delivery.
